sloka: महावीर्यो महातेजा अचिरात् संजनिष्यति ।गरेण सहितः श्रीमान् मा शुचः कमलेक्षणे ॥१-७०-३५॥
transliteration: mahāvīryo mahātejā acirāt saṁjaniṣyati ।gareṇa sahitaḥ śrīmān mā śucaḥ kamalekṣaṇe ॥1-70-35॥

translations.english: 'O Great lady a child of high prowess, lustre and virtues is growing in your womb. In a short time this glorious son carrying with him the poison (administered to you) will be born. O Lotuseyed lady, do not grieve'.
translations.hindi: हे कौशिक ! आपका तप और बल अचिन्त्य है । आपके गुण अपार हैं
